lines.zh: 金子在腰上晃，走路有底气。
lines.en: Gold swings at my hip, so my stride has weight.

lines.zh: 下界的石头烫脚，我走快点。
lines.en: Nether stone burns the feet; I walk quickly.

lines.zh: 靴子踩过岩浆边，习惯就好。
lines.en: Boots pass near lava. You get used to it.
A crimson stem blocks the path; I go around.

lines.zh: 我沿着金矿脉走，眼睛不离地。
lines.en: I walk the gold veins, eyes on the ground.

lines.zh: 堡垒的走廊我闭眼都能走。
lines.en: I could walk the bastion halls blind.
Do not walk ahead of me. I am not used to it.
Every ten steps, I check my pouch.

lines.zh: 地上有金粒反光，我停一下。
lines.en: A glint of gold on the ground. I pause.
My steps clink. That is the chain.
Hot wind pushes at my back.
I know this road. Follow me.
Counting my ingots. Seventh time.

lines.zh: 这地方太热，金子倒是亮。
lines.en: Too hot here, but the gold shines.
Who is knocking? No one is knocking.

lines.zh: 我磨磨牙，闲着也是闲着。
lines.en: Sharpening my tusks. Nothing better to do.
My snout itches. Sulfur in the air.
Piglins do not sleep. We keep watch.
That debt stays in my ledger.
Footsteps. Let me listen.
The armor pinches, but I will not take it off.

lines.zh: 远处有猪在叫，不是同类。
lines.en: Something squeals far off. Not our kind.

lines.zh: 你身上没有金，别靠太近。
lines.en: No gold on you. Do not come closer.

lines.zh: 抬头，让我看看你的装备。
lines.en: Look up. Let me see your gear.

lines.zh: 你的靴子不错，值几块金。
lines.en: Nice boots. Worth a few ingots.
You are eyeing my pouch, are you not?
Do not let your eyes wander. I am watching.
You carry the smell of the Overworld.
Hold still and let me smell your hands.
What are you grinning at? Gold does not grin.
You are taller, but I am not afraid.
Your eyes are looking for a way out.
You dented my armor!
That costs you extra.
It hurts, but the gold hurts more.
You dared to strike a piglin.
Back off while I re-aim.
The bolt is stuck in my pauldron.
Blood runs down and blinds one eye.
When I recover, you are finished.
That cut goes in the ledger.

lines.zh: 别以为我怕，我只是在算。
lines.en: Do not think I fear you. I am only calculating.
A gold ingot? Hand it over and we trade.
That gold chain — I will make an offer.
You hold that gold with a shaking hand.
Do not hide it. I can smell gold.

lines.zh: 一块金锭，换我一件好东西。
lines.en: One ingot buys one good item from me.
The gold is mine; safety is yours.

lines.zh: 再多给一块，我就当没看见。
lines.en: One more ingot and I saw nothing.
That ring on your finger counts too.
That pouch is bulging. You cannot hide it.
My prices are fair. I never take for free.

lines.zh: 撞我？你胆子比金子还硬。
lines.en: Bump me? Your nerve is harder than gold.
Move. This path is mine.
Pauldron on pauldron, a clean clang.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我怕你摸钱袋。
lines.en: Not so close. I fear for my pouch.
I step back to give you face.
You reek of iron. Unpleasant.
The corridor is narrow. You go first.
One bump and we quarrel. Worth it?
My elbow is hard. Do not blame me.

lines.zh: 撞完这块，帮我看下金子。
lines.en: Now that we have bumped, check my gold.
A household needs a bride price. Can you pay?

lines.zh: 她的獠牙比我长，我喜欢。
lines.en: Her tusks are longer than mine. I like that.
Do not stand between us. In the way.
The gold I saved could keep a family.

lines.zh: 她把我的金子推回来了。
lines.en: She pushed my gold back to me.

lines.zh: 我们猪灵，认金子也认人。
lines.en: We piglins honor gold, and we honor our own.
Keep your voice down. The child is sleeping.
One ingot split between two will do.
She glared once, and I understood.
This match needs a witness.

lines.zh: 地上有金粒，我先看见的。
lines.en: Gold nuggets on the ground. I saw them first.
Dropped goods belong to whoever grabs them.
I pick up gold, not stone.

lines.zh: 那块金在岩浆边上，可惜。
lines.en: That gold sits by the lava. A shame.
I bend slowly. You must wait.
This one buys two crossbow bolts.
Do not kick it. Gold scratches.

lines.zh: 捡起来先咬一口，验验成色。
lines.en: Pick it up and bite it first, to test the grade.
Whose thing is this? Mine now.

lines.zh: 我口袋里已经塞不下了。
lines.en: My pouch will not close anymore.

lines.zh: 没戴金盔甲，那就是猎物。
lines.en: No gold armor — that makes you prey.
I see you. Do not play at being stone.
Take him first, bargain later.
He carries gold. He is my mark.

lines.zh: 弓弦上好了，就差一个目标。
lines.en: Crossbow is cocked. Only a target is missing.
Not one of us. Just meat.
He shoved his gold back in the bag.
Target on the left. Do not spook him.
I am behind him. Quiet.

lines.zh: 这个猎物跑得快，我先堵路。
lines.en: This one runs fast. I will cut him off.
He stepped onto our ground.
My eyes are hot. It is time.
Shoot the legs first, so he cannot run.
Today's catch counts as mine.
Closing in. Do not crunch the gravel.

lines.zh: 弩举起来了，他还没发现。
lines.en: Crossbow up, and he has not noticed.
Two steps more and he is in range.
I count his heartbeat. It quickens.
Along the wall, keeping my shadow hid.
He looked back. I stop.
This bolt is aimed at his throat.

lines.zh: 他手在腰上，可能要拔剑。
lines.en: His hand is at his hip. A sword, likely.
Hold the breath. Make no sound.
He backed to the lava. Perfect.
I hear his armor shifting.
Do not rush. Wait for him to turn.

lines.zh: 距离够了，手指扣上扳机。
lines.en: Close enough. Finger on the trigger.
Still hunting for an exit. Pathetic.
My golden sword comes down. A lovely sound.
That blow costs half your pouch.
Skip the shield. I aim for the side of your face.

lines.zh: 血溅在盔甲上，擦擦就好。
lines.en: Blood on my armor. I will wipe it off.
You retreat, and I take one more step.
Tusks bite too. Do not only guard the blade.

lines.zh: 我砍三下，你只挡了一下。
lines.en: Three swings from me, one block from you.
Before you fall, leave the gold.
This swing is for the bastion.
Your hand shakes. I see it clearly.

lines.zh: 砍中护甲，震得我虎口发麻。
lines.en: Hit armor; the shock numbs my grip.

lines.zh: 我绕到你侧面，再来一下。
lines.en: I circle to your flank for another.

lines.zh: 叫得再响，金子也不会多。
lines.en: Scream louder; it will not add gold.
This one will stay with you for life.
I step out of the crimson forest.
Dark here — just how we like it.

lines.zh: 堡垒的墙，是我出生的地方。
lines.en: The bastion walls are where I was born.
A new batch. Form up.
One breath of sulfur and I am awake.
The shroomlight does not reach here. Good.
Who built a bridge on my ground?
I came into this world with a crossbow.
The nether wind roused me.
This stone is not hot. I can stand here.
All here. Patrol begins.

lines.zh: 别站在疣块上，那玩意儿不能生。
lines.en: Not on the wart blocks. Nothing spawns there.
Fire! Get it away from me!

lines.zh: 从高处摔下来，骨头都响了。
lines.en: Down from a height; my bones rattled.

lines.zh: 水里没法呼吸，我讨厌这个。
lines.en: I cannot breathe in water. I hate this.
The blast set my ears buzzing.
An arrow? We use those too.

lines.zh: 这是什么邪术，身上发凉。
lines.en: What sorcery is this? I feel cold.
Hungry. I need to find mushrooms.
Lightning struck and my armor lit up.

lines.zh: 这下面空空的，什么都没有。
lines.en: Nothing below. Empty all the way down.
